//: Two package-specific overrides, both load-bearing. @roofing/web#build declares public/** as an input because the staged Oracle dataset lives there and is gitignored: turbo hashes git-tracked files by default, so without this a freshly staged dataset does not change the build hash, turbo replays a cached dist/, and the deploy silently ships the previous data. @roofing/api#test depends on that build because it synthesises the CDK stack, which reads apps/web/dist as a deployment asset — declared here rather than relying on CI step order, since `pnpm test` on its own has to work too.
